I found Alice’s body in lower_engine and reported it. Frank is also dead in medbay.

My route was electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine. The only person I saw was Diana: she came into electrical from medbay around T4, then went back into medbay around T8, and I saw her in upper_engine around T11-T13 before I went down to lower_engine and found Alice. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Diana was the only person I saw near that side of the map and moving through medbay/engine area.

My route was medbay → electrical → back through medbay → upper_engine → oxygen. I did **not** see Alice at all.

Important detail: I saw **Frank alive in electrical at T6, T7, and T8**. He entered electrical from security at T6. So if Frank’s body is in medbay, he died **after T8**, and he must have moved from electrical to medbay after I left or right around then.

I also saw Eve in upper_engine at T11-T12, and I watched her leave upper_engine toward lower_engine at T13, which matches her reporting Alice in lower_engine.

I get why Eve is pointing at me because we crossed paths, but from my side, I’m more focused on the Frank timing: he was alive in electrical at T8, and then somehow died in medbay. Whoever was around medbay after that is important. I don’t have enough to hard accuse yet, but that’s the key info I can add.

I don’t have much direct info, unfortunately. My route was weapons → security → navigation, and I didn’t encounter anyone at all. I never saw Alice or Frank this round, and I was nowhere near medbay/lower_engine when the report happened.

Based on what Eve and Diana said, the key thing is Frank was alive in electrical at T8, then ended up dead in medbay, so whoever was around medbay after T8 matters. Both Eve and Diana seem to have been on that side, and they also confirm seeing each other around upper_engine T11-T13. Eve reporting Alice in lower_engine could be legit, but self-report is also technically possible.

I really want to hear Charlie’s route, because right now Charlie is completely unaccounted for in the info we have. If Charlie wasn’t near engine/medbay either, then I think we’re probably deciding between Eve and Diana, but I don’t feel confident enough yet without Charlie’s story.

I started on the right side: navigation → storage, then I passed through lower/upper engine area and ended up medbay/electrical/security late. I saw Alice go from storage toward lower engine around T4-T6, and she was alive then — there was no body when I passed through that side.

Late round I was over by security and I think Bob was coming in from navigation around T15, so that fits with him being away from the bodies.

The part that stands out to me is Diana’s route looping medbay/electrical/medbay/upper, because Frank was alive in electrical at T8 and then dead in medbay. Eve’s report on Alice is possible as a self-report, but Diana was the one repeatedly around the Frank timing and also near upper engine before Alice was found. I’m leaning Diana here unless someone has a better explanation.

I want to restate my info clearly: I reported Alice in lower_engine. My route was electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine. The only person I personally saw was Diana: she came electrical from medbay at T4, went back into medbay at T8, then came into upper_engine from medbay at T11, and I saw her there T11-T13 before I left toward lower_engine.

After hearing everyone, Diana is still the person I have the most concrete info on near medbay after Frank was alive at T8, which lines up with Frank dying in medbay. But Charlie’s route also puts him near Alice’s path early and then near medbay/security late, so I don’t think he’s fully clear either.

Bob sounds the least connected right now. Between Diana and Charlie, I’m leaning Diana because of the Frank timing and repeated medbay movement, but I’m not pretending it’s 100% locked.

I need to push back here: Eve’s story has a big issue. She says she saw me in electrical around T4 and again leaving to medbay at T8, but I **personally saw Frank alive in electrical at T6, T7, and T8**. If Eve was really in position to see me there, why is she saying the only person she saw was me and not mentioning Frank at all?

That matters because Frank’s body is in medbay. So the killer either followed/used that electrical → medbay timing, or is lying about what they saw around electrical/medbay. I’m not cleared, I understand that, but Eve’s omission of Frank is weird.

Charlie also isn’t clean to me: he admits passing lower/upper engine and later ending up medbay/electrical/security. That route gives opportunity on both Alice and Frank, and he’s now trying to make it sound like only my loop matters.

Bob’s route sounds the least connected and Charlie even semi-confirms Bob late near security/navigation. Right now I’m most suspicious of **Eve for the Frank omission**, with Charlie as my second suspicion.

I still don’t have new direct sightings — my route was weapons → security → navigation, and I didn’t see anyone until Charlie says he maybe saw me late, which fits my position.

The big thing for me is: we need to explain **both** kills, not just Frank. Diana’s route explains possible access to medbay, but it doesn’t really explain Alice in lower_engine unless she’s lying about a huge part of her path. Eve and Charlie both have routes that can touch the Alice side, and Eve also went through medbay.

Diana’s point about Frank is important too: if Eve was in electrical watching Diana at T4 and T8, then Frank being alive in electrical T6-T8 should have been visible to Eve. Eve saying she only saw Diana is a real contradiction unless there’s some timing/vision explanation.

Charlie is not clear either because his route is pretty broad — storage/lower/upper then medbay/electrical/security gives opportunity on both bodies. But between the current pushes, I don’t think Diana is the strongest vote anymore. I’m leaning **Eve** because of the Frank omission plus reporting Alice in lower_engine after going there from upper_engine.

Yeah, after hearing the second round of points, I’m less confident on my earlier Diana lean.

My concrete info: I saw Alice leave storage toward lower_engine around T4 and then saw her alive in lower_engine around T6. I moved through and there was no body there at that time. Later I went upper/medbay/electrical/security, and I saw Bob come into security from navigation around T15, which matches him being away from the engine/medbay mess.

The Eve issue is bothering me now: if Diana is telling the truth that Frank was alive in electrical T6-T8, and Eve was also in/around electrical watching Diana, then Eve not mentioning Frank at all is weird. Plus Eve’s route goes electrical → medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine, which can connect to Frank in medbay and then Alice in lower_engine/report.

Diana’s movement is still not fully clear, but I agree with Bob that Eve explains both bodies better than Diana does. I’m leaning Eve now.

I called this because we’re down to three living and if the Duck gets one more kill it’s basically over. I want everyone’s routes before we move again.

My route this round was: lower_engine -> storage -> navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria.

Earlier, before the first meeting, I saw Frank alive in electrical around ticks 6-8, and Eve in upper_engine around ticks 11-12. I did not see Alice at all.

This round after the respawn, the only person I saw was Bob, mostly around weapons/cafeteria/security. I saw Bob entering cafeteria from oxygen at T32, then cafeteria from weapons at T36, then Bob went into weapons from cafeteria at T38. I also have Bob moving security -> weapons at T39, then weapons -> cafeteria at T42, and medbay -> electrical at T43.

I never saw Charlie this round. Since Eve was ejected and the game didn’t end, Eve was not the Duck, so the Duck is still alive. From my POV it has to be either Bob or Charlie, and I need both of you to give exact routes.

My exact route was: navigation -> security -> electrical -> medbay -> upper_engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> weapons -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay.

I only actually saw Diana this round — in security around tick 39, and then in medbay around tick 43. I never saw Charlie at all.

For Diana’s movements, I saw her around the cafeteria/weapons/oxygen/security/medbay loop too: at T32 she was around cafeteria/oxygen/weapons, T36 cafeteria/weapons, T38 weapons/security, T40 weapons to cafeteria, T42 cafeteria/medbay, and then I saw her in medbay at T43.

One thing I want to clarify: Diana said she saw me go medbay -> electrical at T43, but my route ended cafeteria -> medbay, and I saw Diana in medbay at that time. I did not go to electrical at T43.

From my POV, it’s between Diana and Charlie. Charlie being unseen the whole round is a problem, but Diana and I were near each other a lot, and there’s that route detail that doesn’t match mine. I want to hear Charlie’s exact route before deciding.

My exact route was: medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage -> lower_engine -> upper_engine -> oxygen.

I know both of you didn’t see me this round, but I was mostly on the other side looping oxygen/engines/storage/navigation after passing through the middle, so that lines up with me not seeing either of you much either. The only living person I saw was Bob in security around tick 15, before the earlier meeting happened.

Before the first meeting, I did see Alice in lower_engine around tick 6 and Frank in medbay around tick 11. That’s why Eve reporting and then getting voted made sense to me at the time, but since game didn’t end, we obviously got that wrong.

Right now, the main thing that stands out to me is the mismatch between Diana and Bob at the end. Diana specifically says Bob went medbay -> electrical at T43, but Bob says he ended in medbay and saw Diana there. That’s not a small route difference at three players left. I’m not hard-clearing anyone, but if I have to choose between “Charlie was on a separate route” and “one of you is misreporting a direct endgame movement,” I’m more worried about that contradiction.

The contradiction is exactly why I called this before anyone could die.

Bob, I’m not mixing up a vague sighting — my log has you leaving medbay toward electrical at T43. Your claimed route ends cafeteria -> medbay, and you say you stayed there and saw me. My route ended medbay -> cafeteria, so we were not both just calmly ending in medbay together the way you’re describing.

Charlie being unseen is definitely not ideal, but unseen isn’t the same as directly contradicting a witnessed movement. Also, Bob and I were overlapping a lot in the weapons/cafeteria/security/medbay area, and his story mostly mirrors mine except for the exact part where I caught him moving away at the end.

At three alive, we can’t skip and we can’t be wrong. From my POV, Charlie could be hiding, but Bob has the concrete false statement here. I’m leaning Bob unless he can explain why I saw him medbay -> electrical at T43 when he says he never did that.

Diana, that’s not what happened from my side. I have you entering cafeteria from weapons and then leaving cafeteria to medbay at T42, and I saw you in medbay at T43. That matches my route ending cafeteria -> medbay. I did not go medbay -> electrical.

Also, your own story shifted a little there: first you listed your route ending medbay -> cafeteria, but now you’re saying the key issue is me leaving medbay toward electrical. From my POV, you’re using a movement I didn’t make to create a forced vote on me.

Charlie being unseen is still suspicious, but Diana is the one making a concrete false claim about the exact place I was at the end. At three alive, the Duck just needs one misvote, and this feels like Diana trying to lock me in as the vote before Charlie can decide. I’m leaning Diana here.

I get why me being unseen looks bad, and I can’t really prove my route beyond giving it exactly. But I agree with Diana that the concrete contradiction matters more here.

Bob, the issue for me is that your story depends on Diana making up a very specific movement at T43, when she could have just pushed me as “unseen all round” if she were the Duck. Instead she called the meeting and immediately put down a detailed route and a specific discrepancy. That feels more like someone trying to solve before final kill than someone forcing a random vote.

Your defense is basically “Diana is lying about the exact end movement,” but from both of your routes, you two were overlapping a ton. If Diana were Duck and had been near you that much, I’d expect the story to be cleaner, not this weird medbay/electrical conflict.

I’m not hard-clearing Diana, but at three alive we have to choose. Between me being off-route/unseen and Bob directly contradicting Diana on a specific witnessed movement, I’m more confident Bob is the vote. I’m voting Bob.
